subject: Request: short trial extension while PO processes (Acme Solutions)
messages:
From: Samuel Price <s.price@acmesolutions.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short trial extension while PO processes

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team is already running quick benchmarks. Procurement has flagged a requirement for an internal SOW and a PO number before they can cut payment, and they estimate the legal/finance loop will take 10-12 business days.

We were hoping Redwood could provide either: 1) a short trial-extension (2 weeks) on the existing account, or 2) provisional trial credits so the team can complete the evaluation while the PO is processed. Do you have a standard policy for this? We do have an SOW draft attached for your reference.

We really want to move forward but can’t complete the purchase until the PO is in place. Any temporary option would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Price
Head of Cloud Architecture, Acme Solutions
Attachments: Acme_SOW_Draft.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Price <s.price@acmesolutions.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension while PO processes

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the SOW.

I can absolutely escalate this and get a provisional solution in place. Two quick Qs so I can expedite with Sales Ops:
- Rough ETA for PO issuance from your finance team? (you mentioned ~10 business days)
- Does procurement need an official quote or any specific billing address fields populated on an invoice?

My plan: I will request a 14-day provisional credit allocation tied to deal RWI-9876-Acme while legal/finance finish the PO. If Sales Ops approves, I’ll provide a redemption code and note that usage will be charged once the PO is received (or we can apply a credit if the PO references the invoice).

Looping in Monica from Sales Ops to confirm process. I’ll mark this high priority.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: urgent provisional credits request for Acme (RWI-9876-Acme)

Monica — can you approve a 14-day provisional credit allocation for Acme while their procurement finishes the PO? Details below:

- Account: Acme Solutions (Deal RWI-9876-Acme)
- Contact: Samuel Price (Head of Cloud Architecture) — s.price@acmesolutions.com
- Reason: Procurement requires SOW/PO; expected PO delay ~10 business days
- Ask: 14 days / up to $2,500 in usage credits tied to account; redeemable via one-time code.
- Special handling: Do not auto invoice until PO is received. If PO references the provisional invoice, credits can be applied.
- Related docs: Acme_SOW_Draft.pdf (attached by prospect)

Customer is engineering-led and ready to start tests today; we see a clear path to purchase once procurement completes. This would prevent the eval from timing out and keep momentum.

If you need legal approval for the SOW language I can loop in our contracts team, but I’m hoping Sales Ops can provision the credits as a standard courtesy.

Thanks — Rafael
